coordinate_derivation.selected_geometry: Exact returned /features/0/geometry/rings/0, preserving all server coordinate values and ring order; ArcGIS ring represented as GeoJSON Polygon.
coordinate_derivation.independent_check: pyproj 3.8.0 inverse EPSG:15384 (SPCS83 New Jersey US survey foot) plus EPSG:1188 NAD83 to WGS84 (1), always_xy. Maximum corresponding-vertex geodesic discrepancy from server result 0.00010277785422706165 metres.
coordinate_derivation.operation_accuracy_not_locator_accuracy: The selected standard EPSG:1188 operation reports 4 metres. This is not source-parcel positional accuracy and is not assigned to horizontal_uncertainty_metres.
coordinate_derivation.unselected_grid_warning: PROJ reported its higher-accuracy New Jersey grid us_noaa_njhpgn.tif unavailable locally. No grid download or silent operation upgrade was attempted; the explicit selected 1188 operation was independently tested.
coordinate_derivation.display_anchor_method: Shapely 2.1.2 Polygon.representative_point() applied to exact returned WGS84 ring, solely for display. It is not a source point, surveyed centroid, entrance or new-building location.

semantics.precision_scope: Only the exact municipal mapped Block 7503 Lot 35.01 parcel is selected to locate the one campus shared by both phases. Not a surveyed cadastral boundary, complete campus boundary, security fence, Phase 2 building footprint or active-work extent. Derived display anchor is not an additional authoritative point. Old Lot 33.01 is not added or inferred merged.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: City expressly warns some GIS data use assumptions and estimates and supplies no numerical positional accuracy. Coordinate digits, projection agreement and transformation operation accuracy are not a survey-accuracy estimate.
